name: Emma
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Emma was written by Jane Austen, first published in 1815.
Emma Woodhouse, confident and well-meaning, meddles in her friends' romantic lives with mixed results -- Austen called her "a heroine whom no one but myself will much like."
Discussion prompt: Matchmaking & Misjudgment is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
